interpretation.origin_guardrail: This is adjacent-day same-condition repeatability, not independent operating-point validation. Repeatable c2 or its magnitude-equivalent first-order zero supports a stable readout-shape candidate, but cannot by itself distinguish readout electronics from a detector-model deficiency that repeats under the same operating condition. The XXF-1 LPF state during the 2024-12-05/06 acquisition remains unverified. No production data or production noise model are modified.
